Before you choose

  • Online participation expectedSchool policy

    Standard online university courses follow a course calendar and require academic participation. Access is flexible, but simply viewing a course does not satisfy engagement requirements. This does not establish a live meeting time for a particular course.

    TESU current undergraduate course engagement and course calendars

  • Online assessment formats varySchool policy

    Standard online university courses can use written assignments, discussions, proctored or nonproctored examinations, or other comprehensive assessments. The exact assessments for an individual university course are not classified here; this does not describe outside providers or every TESU credit-earning method.

    TESU current standard online-course assessment formats

  • Four-week course optionsSchool policy

    TESU offers four-week accelerated sections for undergraduate learners as a separate course format. A specific course’s accelerated section and registration dates must be available; this standard online-course baseline does not assume those alternatives or promise a completion date.

    TESU accelerated undergraduate course format as a separate option

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 9–15 credits per university term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Uses published standard out-of-state undergraduate tuition, effective August 2026. New Jersey/Pennsylvania resident, military, corporate-partner and alumni discounts or waivers are not applied.
  • The tuition scenario uses eligible TESU online, Guided Study, Accelerated or e-Pack courses. TECEP and portfolio assessments are billed separately and are not substituted for those courses.
  • The selected academic route retains the standard 15-credit TESU course-residency requirement. Edison Accelerate is a separate paid waiver scenario and is not included.
  • TESU charges $4,652 for a term of 9–18 eligible credits and $584 per credit below 9. The assumed 9–15 credits per term are a planning scenario; prerequisites, course availability and advisor-approved loads can change the number of billed terms.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
